tools.name: list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List the transactions of a balance account or account holder between createdSince and createdUntil (ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Pass the cursor from the response's _links for the next page.

balancePlatform.description: The unique identifier of the [balance platform](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/balanceplatform/latest/get/balancePlatforms/{id}__queryParam_id).  Required if you don't provide a `balanceAccountId` or `accountHolderId`.

paymentInstrumentId.description: The unique identifier of the [payment instrument](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/balanceplatform/latest/get/paymentInstruments/_id_).  To use this parameter, you must also provide a `balanceAccountId`, `accountHolderId`, or `balancePlatform`.  The `paymentInstrumentId` must be related to the `balanceAccountId` or `accountHolderId` that you provide.

accountHolderId.description: The unique identifier of the [account holder](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/balanceplatform/latest/get/accountHolders/{id}__queryParam_id).  Required if you don't provide a `balanceAccountId` or `balancePlatform`.  If you provide a `balanceAccountId`, the `accountHolderId` must be related to the `balanceAccountId`.

balanceAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the [balance account](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/balanceplatform/latest/get/balanceAccounts/{id}__queryParam_id).  Required if you don't provide an `accountHolderId` or `balancePlatform`.  If you provide an `accountHolderId`, the `balanceAccountId` must be related to the `accountHolderId`.

cursor.description: The `cursor` returned in the links of the previous response.

createdSince.description: Only include transactions that have been created on or after this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

createdUntil.description: Only include transactions that have been created on or before this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

sortOrder.description: Determines the sort order of the returned transactions. The sort order is based on the creation date of the transaction.  Possible values:   - **asc**: Ascending order, from oldest to most recent.  - **desc**: Descending order, from most recent to oldest.  Default value: **asc**.

limit.description: The number of items returned per page, maximum of 100 items. By default, the response returns 10 items per page.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.title: Read a transaction
tools.description: Read one transaction by its id, for example EVJN4227C224222B5JQ8QC7B24C6Q8.

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.title: List transfers
tools.description: List transfers between createdSince and createdUntil (ISO 8601), optionally for one balance account, account holder or payment instrument, or one category such as bank, internal or card.

balancePlatform.description: The unique identifier of the [balance platform](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/balanceplatform/latest/get/balancePlatforms/{id}__queryParam_id).  Required if you don't provide a `balanceAccountId` or `accountHolderId`.

accountHolderId.description: The unique identifier of the [account holder](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/balanceplatform/latest/get/accountHolders/{id}__queryParam_id).  Required if you don't provide a `balanceAccountId` or `balancePlatform`.  If you provide a `balanceAccountId`, the `accountHolderId` must be related to the `balanceAccountId`.

balanceAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the [balance account](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/balanceplatform/latest/get/balanceAccounts/{id}__queryParam_id).  Required if you don't provide an `accountHolderId` or `balancePlatform`.  If you provide an `accountHolderId`, the `balanceAccountId` must be related to the `accountHolderId`.

paymentInstrumentId.description: The unique identifier of the [payment instrument](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/balanceplatform/latest/get/paymentInstruments/_id_).  To use this parameter, you must also provide a `balanceAccountId`, `accountHolderId`, or `balancePlatform`.  The `paymentInstrumentId` must be related to the `balanceAccountId` or `accountHolderId` that you provide.

reference.description: The reference you provided in the POST [/transfers](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/transfers/latest/post/transfers) request

category.description: The category of the transfer.  Possible values:   - **bank**: A transfer involving a [transfer instrument](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/legalentity/latest/post/transferInstruments#responses-200-id) or a bank account.  - **card**: A transfer involving a third-party card.  - **internal**: A transfer between [balance accounts](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/balanceplatform/latest/post/balanceAccounts#responses-200-id) within your platform.  - **issuedCard**: A transfer initiated by an Adyen-issued card.  - **platformPayment**: Funds movements related to payments that are acquired for your users.  - **topUp**: An incoming transfer initiated by your user to top up their balance account.

createdSince.description: Only include transfers that have been created on or after this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format and not earlier than 6 months before the `createdUntil` date. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

createdUntil.description: Only include transfers that have been created on or before this point in time. The value must be in ISO 8601 format and not later than 6 months after the `createdSince` date. For example, **2021-05-30T15:07:40Z**.

sortOrder.description: Determines the sort order of the returned transfers. The sort order is based on the creation date of the transfers.  Possible values:   - **asc**: Ascending order, from oldest to most recent.  - **desc**: Descending order, from most recent to oldest.  Default value: **asc**.

cursor.description: The `cursor` returned in the links of the previous response.

limit.description: The number of items returned per page, maximum of 100 items. By default, the response returns 10 items per page.

tools.name: get_transfer
tools.title: Read a transfer
tools.description: Read one transfer by its id, with its status and amount.

tools.name: transfer_between_balance_accounts
tools.title: Move funds between balance accounts
tools.description: Move funds from one balance account to another on the same platform. amount is {"currency": "EUR", "value": 1000} in minor units; counterparty is {"balanceAccountId": "BA..."}; category is internal.

tools.name: return_transfer
tools.title: Return an incoming transfer
tools.description: Return an incoming internal transfer, by its id, in full or in part (amount in minor units).

transferId.description: The id of the incoming transfer to return.

body.description: The amount to return and your reference.

tools.name: approve_transfers
tools.title: Approve transfers
tools.description: Approve transfers that wait for approval, by their ids, for example ["3JNC3O5ZVFLLGV4B"].

tools.name: cancel_transfers
tools.title: Cancel transfers
tools.description: Cancel transfers that wait for approval, by their ids.
